auth.role_note: New accounts are always created as Patient. Doctor, Specialist, and Administrator access is granted by an administrator afterward.
auth.doctor_note: For everyone's safety, doctor access isn't granted automatically. Your account is created now; on the next step you'll submit your credentials, and an administrator verifies them before clinical tools unlock.
auth.professional_details_note: Your account is active as a patient in the meantime — clinical tools unlock once an administrator verifies these details.
auth.verify_success: Your email has been verified. You can sign in now.
auth.verify_failed: This verification link is invalid or has expired.
auth.reset_sent: If that email is registered, a reset link has been sent — check your inbox.
auth.license_required: A professional license number is required.
auth.reset_token_missing: This reset link is missing its token.
auth.tagline_desc: One secure place for patients and their care team to book, message, and follow up — together.
auth.point_secure: Every record access is authorized and logged
auth.point_verified: Verified clinicians only — no self-appointed doctors
auth.point_messaging: Direct messaging with your actual care team
auth.phone_hint: Optional, but used for mobile money payments.
auth.application_submitted_body: Your application is now pending review. Your account is on hold until an administrator makes a decision — you won't be able to sign in until then. You'll get an email either way.
auth.verification_document_hint: A photo of your license/ID or diploma. Optional — not required to submit your application.
auth.doctor_age_requirement: You must be at least 21 years old to register as a doctor.
auth.two_factor_body: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code, or use one of your recovery codes.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.no_upcoming: You don't have any upcoming appointments.
appointments.no_open_slots: No open slots on this date — try another day.
appointments.day_full: This doctor has reached their patient limit for this day — try another date.
appointments.appointment_requested_body: Your appointment on {{date}} at {{time}} has been requested and is pending the doctor's confirmation. You'll be notified either way.
appointments.phone_invalid: Enter a valid MTN or Orange number (starts with 6).
appointments.check_phone_body: Enter your mobile money PIN on your phone to confirm the payment.
appointments.payment_successful: Payment received — the doctor still needs to confirm your appointment.
appointments.payment_failed: Payment failed — you can try again.
appointments.reschedule_pick_time: Pick a new date and time
appointments.payment_unconfirmed_body: We haven't heard back from the payment provider yet, but your mobile money payment may still go through — this doesn't mean it failed. Check again in a moment, or find it later on your Payments page.

dashboard.title: My Dashboard
dashboard.doctor_app_pending: Your doctor verification application is under review by an administrator. You'll be notified as soon as it's decided — clinical tools stay hidden until then.
dashboard.doctor_app_rejected: Your doctor verification application was not approved. Contact an administrator if you believe this was a mistake.

find_doctor.title: Find a Doctor
find_doctor.full_note: Fully booked for today — try again tomorrow.

records.title: My Records
records.ai_note: The clinical AI assistant is only available to your care team — it does not interact with patients directly.

profile.title: My Profile
profile.password_changed: Password changed. Please sign in again next time with your new password.
profile.specialty_locked_note: Specialty and verification status are set through the doctor verification process and can't be edited here.
profile.two_factor_intro: Add an extra layer of security: after your password, you'll also need a code from an authenticator app to sign in.
profile.two_factor_setup_hint: Add this key to an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
profile.recovery_codes_hint: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe — each can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app. They won't be shown again.
profile.two_factor_active: Two-factor authentication is active on your account.
profile.two_factor_disable_hint: Enter your password to turn off two-factor authentication.
profile.profile_picture_hint: Optional — a personal touch, never required.

doctor.prescribe_anyway: I have reviewed this — prescribe anyway
doctor.daily_limit_note: Cap how many patients you'll accept in a single day. Once reached, your profile shows as "Full" in patient search and no further slots are offered for that day. Leave empty for no cap.
doctor.no_availability_set: No availability set yet — patients won't see any open slots until you add some below.
doctor.transfer_hint: The receiving doctor must accept before the medical record package becomes visible to them.

admin.self_role_note: Roles are set automatically at registration and only change through the doctor-application approval process — administrators cannot reassign a role directly, but can still activate, suspend, or disable an account.
admin.suspend_modal_hint: Choose how long this account should be suspended for. It regains access automatically once this time passes — no need to come back and reactivate it.
admin.suspend_custom_until: Or pick a custom date & time
admin.not_enough_ratings: Not enough ratings yet (need 2+ per doctor).

messages.title: Messages
messages.no_conversations_doctor: No conversations yet — a conversation opens once you have an appointment with a patient.
messages.no_conversations_patient: No conversations yet — book an appointment with a doctor to start messaging them.

support.title: Peer Support
support.intro: Connect with others facing the same condition. You appear here under an anonymous alias — never your real name.
support.no_rooms: No support rooms are available yet.
support.no_messages_yet: No messages yet — be the first to say hello. 💛

payments.title: Payments
payments.verification_note: Payment status is always confirmed directly with Campay server-side — never assumed from the app alone.

errors.network: Can't reach the API. Is the backend running?
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.not_authorized: You are not authorized to do this.

landing.hero_subtitle: Find a verified doctor, book and pay for your appointment, and manage your care from one secure account — in English or French.
landing.hero_card_message: Your prescription is ready to view.
landing.how_1_body: Search generalists and specialists by name, specialty, or clinic, and see who's available now.
landing.how_2_body: Reserve a slot and pay your consultation fee with MTN MoMo or Orange Money through Campay. Your appointment is confirmed instantly.
landing.how_3_body: Message your doctor, view prescriptions and records, and track every visit from one dashboard.
landing.features_title: Everything your care needs, in one place
landing.feature_verified_body: Every Doctor and Specialist account is reviewed and approved by an administrator before they can see patients.
landing.feature_messaging_body: Real-time conversations with your care team, visible only to the people involved in your case.
landing.feature_prescriptions_body: Every prescription is checked for allergy and interaction warnings before it reaches you as a PDF.
landing.feature_payments_body: Pay consultation fees directly on the platform — no separate invoices or bank transfers to track.
landing.feature_records_body: Appointment history, documents, and prescriptions, kept together and accessible whenever you need them.
landing.feature_languages_body: The full platform — from booking to prescriptions — is available in both languages.
landing.clinicians_body: Apply with your medical license during sign-up. An administrator verifies your credentials before any clinical tools unlock — so patients always know who they're talking to.

ratings.thanks_for_rating: Thanks for your feedback — your rating has been submitted.
